python3 -c "
import boto3, os
from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

endpoint = os.getenv('MINIO_ENDPOINT', 'minio:9000')
access   = os.getenv('MINIO_ACCESS_KEY', 'minioadmin')
secret   = os.getenv('MINIO_SECRET_KEY', 'minioadmin')

s3 = boto3.client('s3', endpoint_url=f'http://{endpoint}',
    aws_access_key_id=access, aws_secret_access_key=secret,
    region_name='us-east-1')

for bucket in ['urbanhub', 'citybikes-raw']:
    try:
        s3.head_bucket(Bucket=bucket)
        print(f'Bucket OK: {bucket}')
    except ClientError:
        s3.create_bucket(Bucket=bucket)
        print(f'Bucket cree: {bucket}')

print('MinIO Data Lake pret')
"

INSERT INTO silver_iot_clean
  (sensor_id, location_id, sensor_name, city, latitude, longitude, pollutant, value, unit, datetime_utc, source)
VALUES
  ('{{$json["sensor_id"]}}',
   {{$json["location_id"] !== null ? $json["location_id"] : 'NULL'}},
   {{$json["sensor_name"] ? "'" + $json["sensor_name"].replace(/'/g,"''") + "'" : 'NULL'}},
   {{$json["city"] ? "'" + $json["city"].replace(/'/g,"''") + "'" : 'NULL'}},
   {{$json["latitude"]  !== null ? $json["latitude"]  : 'NULL'}},
   {{$json["longitude"] !== null ? $json["longitude"] : 'NULL'}},
   '{{$json["pollutant"]}}', {{$json["value"]}}, '{{$json["unit"]}}',
   '{{$json["datetime_utc"]}}', '{{$json["source"]}}')
ON CONFLICT (sensor_id, pollutant, datetime_utc) DO NOTHING;

UPDATE iot_processing_state
   SET last_line  = (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(v), last_line) FROM (VALUES ({{$json["_new_last_line"] || 0}})) AS t(v)),
       updated_at = NOW()
 WHERE pipeline = 'bronze_to_silver';

INSERT INTO gold_pollution_hourly
  (sensor_id, pollutant, hour_utc, city, latitude, longitude, avg_value, max_value, min_value, samples_count, computed_at)
SELECT
  sensor_id, pollutant,
  DATE_TRUNC('hour', datetime_utc) AS hour_utc,
  MAX(city), AVG(latitude), AVG(longitude),
  ROUND(AVG(value)::NUMERIC, 2),
  MAX(value), MIN(value), COUNT(*), NOW()
FROM silver_iot_clean
WHERE datetime_utc >= DATE_TRUNC('hour', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 hour'
  AND datetime_utc <  DATE_TRUNC('hour', NOW())
GROUP BY sensor_id, pollutant, DATE_TRUNC('hour', datetime_utc)
ON CONFLICT (sensor_id, pollutant, hour_utc) DO UPDATE SET
  avg_value = EXCLUDED.avg_value, max_value = EXCLUDED.max_value,
  min_value = EXCLUDED.min_value, samples_count = EXCLUDED.samples_count,
  computed_at = NOW();

INSERT INTO gold_pollution_daily_city
  (city, pollutant, day_utc, avg_value, max_value, min_value, samples_count, sensors_count, computed_at)
SELECT
  city, pollutant,
  DATE_TRUNC('day', hour_utc)::DATE AS day_utc,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_value)::NUMERIC, 2), MAX(max_value), MIN(min_value),
  SUM(samples_count), COUNT(DISTINCT sensor_id), NOW()
FROM gold_pollution_hourly
WHERE city IS NOT NULL
  AND hour_utc >= DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 day'
  AND hour_utc <  DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW())
GROUP BY city, pollutant, DATE_TRUNC('day', hour_utc)::DATE
ON CONFLICT (city, pollutant, day_utc) DO UPDATE SET
  avg_value = EXCLUDED.avg_value, max_value = EXCLUDED.max_value,
  min_value = EXCLUDED.min_value, samples_count = EXCLUDED.samples_count,
  sensors_count = EXCLUDED.sensors_count, computed_at = NOW();
